title: deepspeed: torch-load-unsafe @ stage3.py:3770
install: git checkout <pinned tag> (source is vendored under lab/upstream_verify/upstream/)

root_cause.note: Explicit torch.load(weights_only=False) inside the ZeRO-3 universal-checkpoint loader: any actor able to write the checkpoint directory gets pickle code execution when the victim resumes. Reproduced at function level against the verbatim pinned stage3.py; the DeepSpeed package tree is stubbed (no CUDA/MSVC on this Windows host) while torch is the real installed build.

preconditions: attacker can write the ZeRO-3 universal checkpoint directory
victim resumes training with load_optimizer_states for that checkpoint
steps: load the verbatim pinned stage3.py with the DeepSpeed tree stubbed
place a pickled reducing payload at the path the loader reads
call the real loader method and observe marker creation inside torch.load
expected_evidence: marker written by the pickle before any state validation
run.json + log.txt with source hash and post-sink error
cleanup: temporary checkpoint directory under evidence/ is rewritten on every run

static_analysis: Explicit weights_only=False is reachable only with an untrusted checkpoint; candidate is a trust-boundary warning, not a new sink. Static-only.
